d:
Spiritual and motivational speaker Jaya Kishori is in the Guest in the Newsroom. She talks about bhajans, Ram, Krishna and spirituality. Jaya also talks about her hobby of having expensive phones. Shares many things related to Golgappa and Bhajan. She also talks about Dhirendra Shastri and the rumors being spread in her name.
